description: This file defines the DispatchContext class, which is a core component in the OFBiz framework responsible for managing service dispatching, including service resolution, context validation, and WSDL retrieval. It holds references to services, dispatcher, and delegator, and provides methods for service-related operations.

classes.name: DispatchContext
classes.description: The DispatchContext class manages service dispatching, providing methods to retrieve services, validate context, and handle service configurations within the OFBiz framework. It maintains references to the dispatcher, delegator, and service models, and manages a cache of service models for efficiency.

methods.name: DispatchContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a DispatchContext with a name, class loader, and dispatcher, setting up the service model based on the dispatcher’s delegator.

methods.name: getClassLoader
methods.description: Returns the class loader associated with this context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this DispatchContext.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher associated with this context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator associated with the dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: makeValidContext
methods.description: Creates a map of valid parameters for a given service name and mode based on the current context.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelService object for a specified service name.

methods.name: getAllServiceNames
methods.description: Provides a set of all available service names.

methods.name: getWSDL
methods.description: Generates and returns the WSDL document for a specified service.
